claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense: locate_invisible_creatures_in_shared_bright_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing sense surface only supports broad sense kinds like truesight. This rider is narrower: it lets beneficiaries locate Invisible creatures only when both are inside the aura's bright-light area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.
